messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: GPU pool 'gpu-pool-01' sustained high utilization. queue_length=12340, avg_gpu_util=95%, autoscaler failed to scale (max_nodes=8). Suggest immediate attention.

maria (SRE): grabbing logs + metrics. paging in channel. any obvious customer-facing 429 spikes?

kevin (eng-runtime): yes, i see a spike in 429s for v1/text-gen and v1/chat endpoints starting ~1773002400. token_bucket rejections and tier-policy denies. snippets from runtime logs: 

```
[2026-03-14T12:07:22Z] WARN request=abc123 status=429 reason="token_bucket_rejected" tier=pro tokens_needed=45 bucket_tokens=0
[2026-03-14T12:07:23Z] WARN request=def456 status=429 reason="tier_rate_limit" tier=free qps=210 cap=200
[2026-03-14T12:07:24Z] ERROR autoscaler: scale_up failed reason="quota_exceeded" current_nodes=8 max_nodes=8
```

tom (oncall): copy. is autoscaler misconfigured or hitting org quota? where is the limit defined?

kevin (eng-runtime): looks like two issues in tandem: (1) autoscaler cloud quota is 8 for that pool — we hit it. (2) token bucket sizes and per-tier QPS caps were tuned down last week to curb cost; with sudden burst they starved the proxy and caused 429s which backpressure into queue growth -> autoscaler sees backlog but can't scale further.

maria (SRE): confirmed. dashboard: request_queue_latency spikes to 4s median and 12s p99, backlog growing. customer-facing errors ~1.8k/min. we need live mitigation: reduce 429s asap. options: increase token_bucket size, relax tier qps caps, redirect non-critical traffic to fallback smaller model, or increase max_nodes (ask infra quota).

kevin (eng-runtime): i can flip token bucket sizes and disable strict tier enforcement temporarily. plan: 
1) bump token_bucket.size for "pro" and "free" tiers (pro: 500 -> 3000, free: 50 -> 300)
2) relax per-tier qps cap by +25%
3) enable fallback routing for large requests -> route to cpu-fallback model for non-enterprise customers

commands i will run (internal API):
```bash
# bump token bucket sizes
curl -s -X POST "https://infra.internal/api/ratelimit/update" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${INTERNAL_TOKEN}" \\
  -d '{"tier":"pro","bucket_size":3000,"refill_rate":500}'

# relax qps caps
curl -s -X POST "https://infra.internal/api/ratelimit/update" -d '{"tier":"free","qps_cap":250}'

# enable fallback routing for big payloads
curl -s -X POST "https://routing.internal/api/route" -d '{"match":"payload_tokens>2000","target":"cpu-fallback"}'
```

maria (SRE): do it. i'll open a request with cloud-team for quota bump on gpu-pool-01 and prepare an emergency autoscaler override (set max_nodes=12) if they can't raise quota fast enough. also alert support for customer comms.

07:09 tom (oncall): kevin — please post the exact API responses when done so we can roll back if needed.

kevin (eng-runtime): applied changes at 12:10 UTC. API responses: 
```json
{"status":"ok","tier":"pro","bucket_size":3000}
{"status":"ok","tier":"free","qps_cap":250}
{"status":"ok","route":"cpu-fallback","enabled":true}
```

maria (SRE): monitoring now — queue starts dropping within 90s. 429 rate down from ~1800/min to ~120/min. p50 latency back to 300ms, p99 1.2s. autoscaler still at max_nodes=8 waiting on quota.

sophie (support): i've pulled the top 6 customers seeing 429s and opened priority tickets. letting them know we're mitigating and will follow up in 30m with ETA. sending draft comms to #support-escalations.

maria (SRE): cloud-team responded: quota increase request submitted, but typical approve time 2-4 hours. they provided temporary path: manual override via infra-admin to bump pool max to 12 for 1 hour. i'm requesting that now.

kevin (eng-runtime): one caveat: fallback routing increases CPU usage; if we push too much there we risk saturating CPU-bound hosts. i've set an adaptive throttle on fallback to cap it to 30% of total traffic.

12:18 tom (oncall): infra-admin approved manual bump to 12 for 1 hour and autoscaler accepted new limit. maria, please apply.

maria (SRE): applied autoscaler override at 12:19 UTC. logs: 
```
[2026-03-14T12:19:12Z] INFO autoscaler: max_nodes overridden -> 12 by maria (SRE)
[2026-03-14T12:19:15Z] INFO autoscaler: scaling plan started add_nodes=3
```

12:21 kevin (eng-runtime): new nodes coming up. queue shrank to <2k. 429s ~40/min and continue down. overall customer impact reduced to small subset (enterprise accounts unaffected due to dedicated routing).

sophie (support): continuing outreach. one enterprise customer did see degraded throughput for a 7-minute window — flagged for account lead follow-up.

maria (SRE): summary of mitigation timeline: 
- 12:07 alarm fired (queue growth + 429 spike)
- 12:10 token_bucket & qps caps relaxed; fallback routing enabled
- 12:19 autoscaler manual override -> max_nodes=12
- 12:25 queue < 2k, 429s minimal, p50 latency back to baseline

maria (SRE): planned next steps (post-incident):
- revert temporary token_bucket/qps relaxations after traffic stabilizes (rollback plan ready)
- permanent fix: review cost-constrained throttling policy and add safety margin for bursty workloads
- autoscaler: add an emergency policy that can auto-request quota or temporarily burst to reserved capacity where possible
- run an on-call drill for token-bucket-related saturation scenarios

kevin (eng-runtime): immediate action — i'll schedule the rollback to start at 13:00 UTC if metrics remain stable for 30m, and post the runbook for how to tune token buckets/Tier policy.

sophie (support): i will send the post-incident customer note to the affected cohort template and coordinate PRs to account teams.

12:40 maria (SRE): handing off to night oncall priya. all mitigations in place, watchlist dashboard pinned, alerts reduced to warning. if anything spikes re-open this thread and escalate.

priya (next-oncall): taking handoff. ack. i'll keep monitoring through the night and will coordinate with kevin if rollback issues show up.

maria (SRE): :white_check_mark: thanks team. follow-up ticket created: INC-2026-1773002468 with action items and owners.

tom (oncall): thumbs up. good run. add a postmortem with root cause: combination of quota ceiling + overly aggressive cost throttling (token_bucket/tier caps) causing cascading 429s -> queue growth -> autoscaler hitting limit.

sophie (support): adding customer impact details to the incident ticket now.

incident-bot: Incident transitioned to "mitigated" by maria (SRE) at 1773002700
